messages:
maria: FYI hitting a P95 bump on canary after yesterday's microbatcher tweak. p95 for route chat/low-latency in eu-west-1 went from ~320ms -> ~490ms. Can we do a quick sync on dynamic token budget gating?
aj: Ugh. Do we have perf graphs or profiler output? :eyes:
perf-bot: Canary aggregate metrics: p95=489ms (+169ms), p50=86ms (stable). KV cache hit rate dropped 12 percentage points during the incident window. Kernel selection note: some batches fell back to fallback_gemm on A100.
maria: Posted a short profiler snippet — looks like sequence-length distribution shifted and triggered a kernel switchover. Logs:
```
2026-03-18T12:34:01Z batcher: requested_tokens=128 allocated_microbatch=4
kernel: fallback_gemm chosen cost_multiplier=1.8
kv_cache: hits_pct=78 -> 66
```
sasha: My hypothesis: dynamic token_budget_target per route slid too low for chat/low-latency, causing more splits and variance in seq lengths. That mixes short and long requests into same microbatch and trips costy kernel. Suggest forcing a higher token_budget_min for premium tier as a guardrail.
aj: Agreed. Quick config patch suggestion for canary:
```
route_overrides:
  chat/low-latency:
    token_budget_target: 160
    token_budget_min: 96
    max_microbatch: 6
```
ops: Canary slot 3 in eu-west-1 is free, I can roll that. ETA ~5m.
maria: Also enable_kv_prefetch=true on that route as a hint — should push hits back up and reduce fetch tail.
perf-bot: Noted. Deploy started by deploy-bot (dplyr-2026.3.18). Will post results when available.
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated to canary slot 3 (dplyr-2026.3.18).
perf-bot: Canary metrics (t+6m): p95=335ms (-154ms), p50=88ms, kv_hits=81%, kernel choice majority=fast_gemm. Improvement looks solid :thumbsup:.
sasha: Nice. Next step: automated experiment to ramp token_budget_target down slowly until p95 approaches threshold, but keep token_budget_min guardrails per-tier. Also add per-route hysteresis so transient drops don't flip budgets.
aj: I'll build a small harness to simulate seq-length variance and kernel selection probabilities, then push a PR for canary policy + unit test later today.
maria: Thanks all. Follow-up actions: create dashboard tile for route-level kv_hit_ratio and kernel_choice breakdown, and add a canary alert if p95 increases >50ms from baseline. Assign sasha+aj for dashboard/experiment.
ops: Acknowledged. I'll keep slot 3 live for 2 hours and monitor.
maria: Great, will document the config and add notes to the perf runbook. :shipit:
